name: DataWeave
tagline: Upload two databases and get AI-suggested field mappings with confidence scores you can adjust.
problem: Data teams struggle with messy, disconnected sources, and ETL tools hide the human-in-the-loop step.
solution: Visualizes detected schema relationships, suggests mappings between source and target with confidence scores, and lets analysts adjust them.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload two schemas and review the suggested mappings.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “EY Data Integration Challenge” among 124 submissions.
Puts a human in the loop with confidence scores.

lessons: Showing confidence and letting people correct it fits enterprise judges.
